entries.sense_note: guess a cost or amount roughly

def.short: guess a cost, an amount or a size, without measuring it exactly
def.long: To make a careful guess about a cost, an amount, a size or a time, using the information you have, without measuring it exactly.

examples.en: We estimate the cost at about 5,000 lira.
examples.tr: Maliyetin 5.000 lira civarında olacağını tahmin ediyoruz.

examples.en: The builder estimated that the work would take three weeks.
examples.tr: Usta işin üç hafta süreceğini tahmin etti.

examples.en: Experts estimate that 2 million tourists will visit the city this year.
examples.tr: Uzmanlar bu yıl şehri 2 milyon turistin ziyaret edeceğini tahmin ediyor.

tr.note: 'Guess' bilgiye dayanmayan bir tahmin de olabilir. 'Estimate' ise bilgiye dayanan, genelde sayı içeren bir tahmindir. İsmi /ˈɛstɪmət/ okunur: 'a rough estimate'.

quiz.cloze: Engineers ______ that the new bridge will cost 2 billion lira.

entries.sense_note: act or speak for a company or group

def.micro: speak or act for a group
def.short: officially speak or act for another person, a group or a company
def.long: To speak or act officially for another person, a group, a company or a country, for example at a meeting or in a court.

examples.en: Ozan will represent our company at the fair.
examples.tr: Ozan fuarda şirketimizi temsil edecek.

examples.en: She represented Turkey at the Olympics.
examples.tr: Olimpiyatlarda Türkiye'yi temsil etti.

examples.en: The union represents more than 30,000 workers.
examples.tr: Sendika 30.000'den fazla işçiyi temsil ediyor.

tr.note: Temsilciye 'representative', kısaca 'rep' denir: 'a sales rep' (satış temsilcisi).

quiz.cloze: Three managers will ______ our company at the trade fair in Germany.

entries.sense_note: focus on one area of work

def.micro: focus on one area of work
def.short: study or work mainly in one area so that you become an expert in it
def.long: To study or work mainly in one area or subject so that you know a lot about it. A company can also do this by offering one kind of product or service.

examples.en: Elif specializes in tax law.
examples.tr: Elif vergi hukukunda uzmanlaşmış.

examples.en: The shop specializes in second-hand books.
examples.tr: Dükkânın uzmanlık alanı ikinci el kitaplar.

examples.en: After medical school, Can wants to specialize in children's health.
examples.tr: Can tıp fakültesinden sonra çocuk sağlığı alanında uzmanlaşmak istiyor.

tr.note: Hep 'in' ile kullanılır: 'specialize in sth'. İngiliz İngilizcesinde 'specialise' diye de yazılır.

entries.sense_note: offer to do sth without being asked

def.short: offer to do a job or a task without being asked or forced to do it
def.long: To offer to do something, often a task nobody else wants, without being asked. It also means to work without pay to help people.

grammar.pattern: volunteer to do sth; volunteer for sth

examples.en: Nobody volunteered to take notes.
examples.tr: Not almak için kimse gönüllü olmadı.

examples.en: Gizem volunteered to organize the office party.
examples.tr: Gizem ofis partisini düzenlemeye gönüllü oldu.

examples.en: Every weekend, Jack volunteers at an animal shelter.
examples.tr: Jack her hafta sonu bir hayvan barınağında gönüllü çalışıyor.

tr.note: 'Volunteer to do sth' bir şeyi yapmaya gönüllü olmaktır. İsim olarak da 'gönüllü' demektir: 'She's a volunteer.'

quiz.cloze: When the boss asked who could work on Saturday, Mert ______ immediately.

entries.sense_note: give sb a higher position at work

def.short: give someone a more important job with more money in the same company
def.long: To move someone to a higher and more important job in the same company or organization. It is very often used in the passive: 'be promoted'.

examples.en: Zeynep was promoted to manager.
examples.tr: Zeynep müdürlüğe terfi etti.

examples.en: If you work hard, they might promote you next year.
examples.tr: Sıkı çalışırsan seni gelecek yıl terfi ettirebilirler.

examples.en: The company promoted three women to its board this year.
examples.tr: Şirket bu yıl üç kadını yönetim kuruluna yükseltti.

tr.note: Türkçede 'terfi etmek' etkendir, İngilizcede ise terfi alan kişi için edilgen kullanılır: 'I was promoted' (terfi ettim). Bir ürünü tanıtmak da 'promote' olur.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'terfi ettim' etken bir fiil olduğu için 'I promoted' deniyor. İngilizcede terfi alan kişi için edilgen 'be promoted' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: After two years in sales, Elif was ______ to team leader.

entries.sense_note: give ideas or work to a shared result

def.micro: give ideas or work to help
def.short: give your ideas, time, work or money to help something succeed
def.long: To give ideas, work, time or money together with other people to help something succeed. It can also mean to be one of the causes of something.

examples.en: Everyone contributed ideas to the plan.
examples.tr: Herkes plana fikirleriyle katkıda bulundu.

examples.en: Kemal contributed a lot to the project's success.
examples.tr: Kemal projenin başarısına çok katkıda bulundu.

examples.en: Each member contributes 100 lira a month to the fund.
examples.tr: Her üye fona ayda 100 lira katkı payı ödüyor.

tr.note: Hep 'to' ile kullanılır: 'contribute to sth'. İsmi 'contribution' (katkı) olur.

quiz.cloze: Everyone in the team ______ to the final report.

entries.sense_note: having the right training for a job

def.short: having passed the exams or finished the training needed for a job
def.long: Having passed the exams or finished the training that you need to do a particular job, like a nurse or a teacher. It also means having the right skills or experience.

examples.en: We need a qualified electrician.
examples.tr: Kalifiye bir elektrikçiye ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: Hande is a fully qualified nurse.
examples.tr: Hande diplomalı bir hemşire.

examples.en: I don't feel qualified to give advice on this.
examples.tr: Bu konuda tavsiye verecek kadar yetkin hissetmiyorum.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'kalifiye eleman' İngilizcede 'qualified/skilled worker' olur. 'Qualified' daha çok belgeyi ya da diplomayı, 'skilled' ise beceriyi vurgular.

quiz.cloze: Bora isn't a fully ______ doctor yet; he still has one exam to pass.

entries.sense_note: good at a job because of training

def.micro: good at a job by training
def.short: having the ability and experience to do a job well, usually after training
def.long: Having the training and experience to do a job well, especially a practical job. Skilled workers usually earn more money.

examples.en: The factory needs more skilled workers.
examples.tr: Fabrikanın daha fazla nitelikli işçiye ihtiyacı var.

examples.en: My grandfather was a skilled carpenter.
examples.tr: Dedem usta bir marangozdu.

examples.en: There is a shortage of skilled staff in the IT sector.
examples.tr: Bilişim sektöründe nitelikli personel açığı var.

tr.note: 'Skilled worker' nitelikli işçidir; becerisi olmayan işçiye 'unskilled worker' denir. Kişinin genel becerikliliği için 'skilful' (BrE) ya da 'skillful' (AmE) da kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: Building a boat by hand is a job for a very ______ carpenter.

def.short: able to change easily to suit new situations or what people need
def.long: Able to change easily to suit new situations or the needs of other people. For example, flexible hours let you choose when to start and finish work.

examples.en: My job has flexible hours.
examples.tr: İşimin çalışma saatleri esnek.

examples.en: We need someone who is flexible and can work some weekends.
examples.tr: Esnek olan ve bazı hafta sonları çalışabilecek birine ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: Our plans are flexible, so we can change the date if you want.
examples.tr: Planlarımız esnek, istersen tarihi değiştirebiliriz.

tr.note: İş ilanlarında 'flexible hours' ya da 'flexible working' (esnek çalışma) çok geçer. Kolayca bükülebilen nesneler için de kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: With ______ working hours, I can take my son to school before I start.

def.short: working well and quickly without wasting time, money or energy
def.long: Working or doing something well, quickly and without wasting time, money or energy. A person, a machine or a system can be like this.

examples.en: Our new system is much more efficient.
examples.tr: Yeni sistemimiz çok daha verimli.

examples.en: Ece is the most efficient person in the office.
examples.tr: Ece ofiste en verimli çalışan kişi.

examples.en: LED bulbs are more energy-efficient than old ones.
examples.tr: LED ampuller enerji açısından eskilerinden daha verimli.

tr.note: 'Efficient' zaman ve kaynak harcamadan iş görmektir (verimli). 'Effective' ise istenen sonucu vermektir (etkili). Türkçedeki 'efektif' ikincisine yakındır.

quiz.cloze: The new machine is more ______: it uses less power and works faster.

entries.sense_note: wanting to win; good compared to others

def.short: wanting very much to win, or as good as or cheaper than others
def.long: Always wanting to win or to be better than others. It also describes prices, salaries or products that are as good as or better than those of other companies.

examples.en: We offer a competitive salary.
examples.tr: Rekabetçi bir maaş sunuyoruz.

examples.en: My brother is very competitive, even in board games.
examples.tr: Kardeşim kutu oyunlarında bile çok hırslı.

examples.en: The phone market is extremely competitive.
examples.tr: Telefon pazarı son derece rekabetçi.

tr.note: İş ilanındaki 'competitive salary' piyasaya göre iyi bir maaş demektir. Kişi için 'hırslı, hep kazanmak isteyen' anlamına gelir.

quiz.cloze: Ali hates losing; he's very ______, even when we play cards.

def.short: lasting for a very long time or for always, not only for a short time
def.long: Lasting for a long time or for ever. A permanent job has no end date, unlike a job for a few months.

examples.en: Finally, I've got a permanent job.
examples.tr: Sonunda kadrolu bir işim oldu.

examples.en: Is this a permanent position or a temporary one?
examples.tr: Bu kalıcı bir pozisyon mu, yoksa geçici mi?

examples.en: They moved to Berlin, and now it's their permanent home.
examples.tr: Berlin'e taşındılar; artık orası onların kalıcı yuvası.

tr.note: İş için 'permanent job' süresiz, kadrolu iş demektir. Zıddı 'temporary' (geçici) olur.

quiz.cloze: After a six-month trial, my job became ______, so now it has no end date.
